subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly via Guangzhou to Guiyang and discover Guizhou: Yelang Valley, the Qingyun Market pedestrian street, the Pingtang Sky Eye (FAST radio telescope) and Huangguoshu Waterfall, one of Asia’s famous waterfalls. Stay in local 5-star hotels in Guiyang and Anshun, with bottled water provided. A no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 20–25 2026 to Mar 21–26 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Yelang Valley: A themed scenic area in Guiyang built around the Yelang culture, known as the Kingdom of Stones.
placeDesc.Qingyun Market: A trendy pedestrian street in Guiyang that has become famous online for its shops and food.
placeDesc.Jiaxiu Pavilion: A historic three-storey pavilion on a river island in Guiyang, a city landmark.
placeDesc.Guiyang North Catholic Church: A Catholic church in Guiyang visited together with Jiaxiu Pavilion.
placeDesc.Pingtang Sky Eye: A huge radio telescope in a Guizhou valley, known as FAST, visited at its scenic area.
placeDesc.Anshun Academy: A historic academy in Anshun, visited on the way to Huangguoshu.
placeDesc.Huangguoshu Waterfall: One of the best-known waterfalls in Asia, set in a scenic park near Anshun.
placeDesc.The White House Guiyang: A white landmark building in Guiyang visited as a city photo stop.
placeDesc.Guiyang Twin Towers: A pair of tall towers in Guiyang, a modern city landmark.
placeDesc.Dolphin Square: A landmark commercial complex in Guiyang's Huaguoyuan Orchard Business District.
placeDesc.Hi-Le District: A Guiyang district with a food street and the Hi-Le Fashion Mall.
